senses.def: A basic level emergency medical technician that has passed national registry examination; trained less extensively than the advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic (EMT-P) level

An intermediate-level emergency medical technician who has passed national registry examination and worked extensively as an EMT-B, but who is not yet a paramedic (EMT-P) level, though usually training to become one.

forms_of: Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act

senses.def: A maytansinoid cytotoxic agent used, conjugated with the antibidy trastuzumab, in the drug Trastuzumab emtansine

A synthetic nucleoside reverse-transcriptase inhibitor C₈H₁₀FN₃O₃S (trademarks Atripla, Complera, Emtriva, Stribild, Truvada) administered orally typically in conjunction with other antiretroviral agents for the treatment of HIV infection.
